name: @pellux/goodvibes-agent
description: GoodVibes personal operator assistant TUI with a proactive Agent product brain, isolated Agent Knowledge, local profiles, routines, skills, personas, and explicit build delegation.

scripts.build: bun build src/main.ts --compile --outfile dist/goodvibes-agent && bun run scripts/stage-browser-driver.ts
scripts.build:linux-x64: bun build src/main.ts --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile dist/goodvibes-agent-linux-x64 && bun run scripts/stage-browser-driver.ts
scripts.build:linux-arm64: bun build src/main.ts --compile --target=bun-linux-arm64 --outfile dist/goodvibes-agent-linux-arm64 && bun run scripts/stage-browser-driver.ts
scripts.build:macos-x64: bun build src/main.ts --compile --target=bun-darwin-x64 --outfile dist/goodvibes-agent-macos-x64 && bun run scripts/stage-browser-driver.ts
scripts.build:macos-arm64: bun build src/main.ts --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile dist/goodvibes-agent-macos-arm64 && bun run scripts/stage-browser-driver.ts
scripts.build:windows: bun build src/main.ts --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 --outfile dist/goodvibes-agent-windows.exe && bun run scripts/stage-browser-driver.ts
scripts.build:all-shell: bun run build:linux-x64 && bun run build:linux-arm64 && bun run build:macos-x64 && bun run build:macos-arm64 && bun run build:windows
scripts.ci:gate: bun run typecheck && bun run typecheck:test && bun run build && bun run test && bun run coverage:gate && bun run architecture:check && bun run workflows:check && bun run perf:check && bun run publish:check && bun run package:install-check && bun run verification:ledger
